to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
EQUAL TEE BODY FOR OIL-HYDRAULIC COUPLINGS 

PART I TEE BODY MADE FROM FORGINGS 



*. Scope — Specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements foF-eanal tee body made 
from forgings for use in oil-hydraulic systems. * * 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

3. Material — Steel according to Class 1A IS : 1875-1978 'Specification for carbon steel billets, 
blooms, slabs and bars for forgings (fourth revision ) ' or any other steel as agreed to between the 
user and the manufacturer. 

4. Surface Protection — Tee bodies are to be phosphated to Class A2 of IS : 3618-1966 'Specifica- 
tion for phosphate treatment of iron and steel for protection against corrosion ', unless otherwise 
agreed to between the user and the manufactumr. 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 These tee bodies are intended for assembly in accordance with Type C of ' Indian Standard 
Specification for tee assemblies for oil-hydraulic systems ( under preparation ) \ 

5.2 For details not covered in thfi^standard, reference shall he made to IS : 8805 ( Part I )-1978 
1 General requirements for fefrule type couplings used in oil hydraulic systems: Part I General '. 

6- Designation — Equal tee body of light series L for outside diameter of tube 6 mm and conform- 
ing to this standard shall be designated as: 

Equal Tee body L6 IS : 9389 ( Part I )

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard covers tee bodies made from forgings only. The tee bodies made from bar 
stock are covered in IS: 9389 (Part II )-1979 'Specification for equal tee body for oil-hydraulic 
couplings: Part II Tee body made from bar stock \ 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from the 
following standards: 

BS 4368 Specification for carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tubes: Part 1- 
1972 Heavy series ( Metric); and Part 3-1974 Light series ( Metric ). 

DIN 3908-1965 Non-soldered taper-bush type pipe unions; ■ Tee ' for use with union nut. 



Adopted 19 December 1979
